name: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend)
aliases: GPU Ray-Cast Volume Rendering with Composite Blending
GPU Volume Ray Casting with Composite Blending
GPU Volume Ray Casting with VTK
VTK OpenGL GPU Volume Ray Cast Mapper
definition: A hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique using VTK's vtkGPUVolumeRayCastMapper with composite blending mode to render 3D medical datasets (CT/MRI) by accumulating color and opacity along rays.
summary: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend) is a direct volume rendering technique that offloads ray casting to the GPU for performance while supporting accurate lighting models and adaptive shading.
